states.trigger: Link lost; device-owned timeout, never inferred by Jev.
states.visual: Resting closed lids; keep the same blue body and retain mood internally.

states.trigger: No sessions, as the core derives; not a mood.
states.visual: Shared sleepy face; no angry-sleeping catalogue. From the second round of rests on, now and then a snore: two soft breaths, each a slight swell.

states.trigger: Sessions exist but none are working.
states.visual: Show mood face, soft breathing and occasional quiet gesture; from the second round of gestures on, now and then a yawn, a doze that snaps awake, or a sneeze.

states.trigger: Actual mic capture / push-to-talk, not every user prompt.
states.visual: Lean toward user; tiny pulsing listen cue, no invented transcript.

states.trigger: Core-confirmed session/task/continuation start, or a context compacted; ctx selects the wording.
states.visual: Same body perks up beside a rounded START/NEW TASK/RESUME/COMPACTED card.

states.trigger: Plan mode or planning tool classification.
states.visual: Same computer; pause typing to arrange a few task dots.

states.trigger: Working without a more specific act.
states.visual: Same keyboard; irregular typing bursts and thinking rests.

states.trigger: Shell/CLI classified by Act.of; tests/inspect override shell.
states.visual: Same keyboard; softly scrolling generic code, never real command contents.

states.trigger: Generic edit/MCP/unknown tool only after specific classification.
states.visual: Same computer; simple gear/link icon, not a new character.

states.trigger: Web tool currently running.
states.visual: Computer search card with soft magnifier, not the private query.

states.trigger: Read/search/inspect tool as classified; no guessed post-search phase.
states.visual: Same computer; inspect result cards and think.

states.trigger: Topic tests, even when the tool is Bash.
states.visual: Same computer; neutral test progress dots, no fake PASS/FAIL outcome.

states.trigger: Main-agent delegation tool or observed live helper.
states.visual: Same desk plus two/three tiny original gel helpers; no new hero body.

states.trigger: Observed subagent end; do not presume success or invent a start.
states.visual: One small helper returns beside the same body with a neutral report card.

states.trigger: Tool silence/pending grace as core derives; not an unresolved approval sign.
states.visual: Keep desk and mood; still attentive pauses with no loading panic.

states.trigger: Authoritative attention snapshot / wait for permission or input.
states.visual: Rounded alert in upper 80%; large surface taps then recognizable ding; text lane clear.

states.trigger: Authorized reply finish; not all turn-end events are success.
states.visual: Neutral READY card and gentle present gesture, no trophy.

states.trigger: Authorized finish, with explicit outcome success/failure.
states.visual: Success COMPLETE+trophy; failure TRY AGAIN/FAILED struggle, never a victory cue.

states.trigger: Observed tool failure class; not automatically failed whole task.
states.visual: Small jolt and readable warning with desk retained underneath.

states.trigger: Interrupted/stopped turn, not failure.
states.visual: Brake movement gently, STOPPED card; never punish an interrupt.

states.trigger: Ordinary tap; needs-you tap follows existing open-thread semantics, never approval.
states.visual: Local indentation, face follows surface, rebound on same body.

states.trigger: Existing device/core repeated-tap classification.
states.visual: Bounded recoil or wobble complaint; preserve face mood unless host changes it.

states.trigger: The brain's reaction to the person back at the Mac after a long break; the mood comes with it.
states.visual: Same body stretches up and forward, then settles; the start family without a card.

states.trigger: The board's own reaction to what you do to it: BOOT's hand-off, a stroke, one the wrong way, a boop on the nose, a tickle, a shake, a pick-up, a put-down, a thump on the desk, turned face up again. The board names the gesture, and its take is that gesture's.
states.visual: The same body acts the gesture out with a gag of its own (keyed squash, stretch, lean, slide and lids) under a face it borrows for it: offers, melts, bristles, squishes, giggles, wobbles, stretches up, lands, jumps, rises from below.

states.trigger: The brain's reaction when you name it in your prompt: it heard its name.
states.visual: The same body looks up at you, surprised and pleased, under a face it borrows for it: perks up and leans in, hops and beams, or tilts toward you; the start family without a card.
